title: synotis tetrantha
intro: Synotis tetrantha, commonly known as the Himalayan synotis, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, cough, and other respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and fighting infections. The therapeutic actions of Synotis tetrantha include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which help in soothing the body and alleviating symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Synotis tetrantha include flavonoids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
